pathways: negative regulation of voltage-gated potassium channel activity

function.text: KCNQ1 encodes potassium voltage-gated channel subfamily KQT member 1. Annotated molecular activities include voltage-gated potassium channel activity and delayed rectifier potassium channel activity. It participates in negative regulation of voltage-gated potassium channel activity and negative regulation of delayed rectifier potassium channel activity.

germline.text: Retained constitutional disease associations include Jervell and Lange-Nielsen syndrome (autosomal recessive); long QT syndrome (autosomal dominant). Pathogenicity and inheritance depend on the specific allele and disorder.

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.
